name: Detail drawer
summary: A side sheet for one record shown open: name, status, previous and next, the key fields, an attachment and a sticky footer with the two decisions. Where it slides in from is the project's.
use: to open one record from a list without leaving the list
a11y: A labelled dialog region; every icon button (previous, next, close, open file) has an accessible name, fields are a description list, and the footer actions are real buttons.

use_when: stepping through a queue of records one by one, with previous and next, while the list stays in view
avoid_when: a short yes-or-no question with no record behind it: use confirm-dialog
the decision needs the approval steps and the balance effect laid out: use approval-panel
a cart or checkout side sheet: use cart-drawer

parts.name: title
parts.what: the record's name, on one line

parts.name: position
parts.what: where this record sits in the list, such as '5 of 14'

parts.name: nav
parts.what: previous, next and close icon buttons

parts.name: amount
parts.what: the headline amount, with cents and currency set smaller

parts.name: subtitle
parts.what: one or two short lines under the amount: due date, what happens next

parts.name: person
parts.what: a small round photo beside a person's name in a field

parts.name: file
parts.what: the attachment: name, type and size, and an open button

empty.how: for a field with no value, show a muted dash in its value cell; with no record picked, do not open the drawer

loading.how: keep the header and footer and fill the amount and each field value with a muted block; disable both decision buttons

error.how: if the record fails to load or a decision fails, put an alert-banners line at the top of the body and keep the footer

disabled.how: on the first or last record, set disabled on the previous or next button; after a decision, disable both footer buttons

overflow.how: the body scrolls on its own between the fixed header and the sticky footer

long_text.how: the title and file name are cut with an ellipsis; field values break anywhere rather than overflow

keyboard: Tab moves through Previous, Next and Close, the open-file button, then Reject and Approve
Enter or Space presses the focused button
The file has no script: Esc does not close it and Previous and Next do nothing until wired
